subject: Request: Convert contract kernel engineer (latency) to FTE + comp band uplift
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@recruiting.co>
Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Convert contract kernel engineer (latency) to FTE + comp band uplift

Hi Kim & Marissa —

Quick summary: Eva Chen (contractor in Kernel team, focusing on low-latency attention kernels) has been on contract since Nov '24. The team wants to convert her to FTE immediately to preserve momentum on the seq2seq latency work and to avoid losing her to open-market offers. Manager ask: convert contractor to FTE and bump from comp band L3 -> L4 (midpoint move) due to market comps and her performance (two production patches shipped, measurable 12% p95 improvement on long-form generators).

What I'm asking for from this thread:
- Headcount approval to convert 1 contractor slot -> 1 FTE (Platform/Runtime).
- One-time comp-band uplift approval (L3->L4) for the offer. Proposed OTE band in attached xlsx (base + equity range).
- Confirmation on funding source (we propose reassigning Q2 internship carve + small tranche from kernel hiring reserve; q2 csv attached).

Why this matters now:
- Eva has a verbal offer from another startup that will close in 2 weeks. We will lose critical kernel ownership which would delay the telemetry + KV cache changes planned for H2.
- Replacing the role externally is high-risk given niche infra skill set and ramp time (6-9 months). Conversion is cost-neutral in headcount bucket (contractor -> FTE) but needs approval for comp uplift beyond standard conversion guidance.

Attachments: JD-LatencyKernelEngineer.pdf, comp-band-proposal-evachen.xlsx, q2-headcount-reallocation.csv

Can we get a quick decision path? If you want, I can route to FinOps for a tight cost delta summary; otherwise would appreciate a band decision and headcount sign-off so People Ops can prepare the offer.

Thanks,
Mateo
Principal Platform Eng, Runtime
Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@recruiting.co>
Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert contract kernel engineer (latency) to FTE + comp band uplift

Thanks for the write-up, Mateo. Quick read and initial guidance from Comp & People Ops:

1) Conversion path: contractors converting to FTE are allowed if manager justification is clear (product/impact + retention risk). That part is fine.
2) Band uplift: moving L3 -> L4 is an exception and needs both Manager + Director sign-off + confirmation of funding. For exceptions > 10% over L3 midpoint we require Exec HR (Mina) approval.
3) Paperwork: People Ops will need the finalized base/equity numbers and a 1-paragraph justification we can attach to the packet.

Notes on numbers: the spreadsheet shows a base that would put Eva slightly above L4 midpoint at total comp. If you can land slightly lower on base and use equity to bridge, we reduce immediate cash pressure and make FinOps happier.

Next step suggestions:
- Mateo, can you provide a 2-paragraph manager justification and the target base + equity you intend to offer?
- Marissa, can you confirm whether we can pull the internship carve (line item in q2 csv) and show a balanced funding plan?

I can vet the packet quickly once those pieces are in. If this needs to be expedited, mark as "exec urgent" and we'll route to Mina for fast approval.

Best,
Kimberly
Head of Talent Operations (interim)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@recruiting.co>, FinOps <finops@redwood-partner.io>
Date: Wed, 09 Apr 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert contract kernel engineer (latency) to FTE + comp band uplift

On Tue, Apr 8, 2025 at 9:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary: Eva Chen (contractor in Kernel team...) has been on contract since Nov '24. The team wants to convert her to FTE immediately...

Thanks, Mateo. I reviewed the q2-headcount-reallocation.csv. We have two options:

A) Approve conversion + full L3->L4 uplift now, funded by internship carve + 30% from kernel hiring reserve. This consumes a non-trivial portion of the reserve and would reduce our open requisition capacity by ~1.2 FTE equivalent for Q2.

B) Approve conversion with conditional L3->L3.5 (mid-step) where base sits at high L3 and target equity includes a 1-year performance grant that vests over 12 months. That reduces near-term cash by ~18% vs option A and buys time to shift more budget in Q3 if needed.

Given the retention risk and the specialized nature of the role (low-latency kernels), my recommendation is option B unless Exec greenlight required by the manager. I'm also looping FinOps for the cost delta spreadsheet; @FinOps please see the attached q2 csv and confirm accounting treatment of internship carve reassignments.

If Exec sign-off is required, @Mina can you advise whether the committee is willing to approve a full L4 uplift for critical hires or prefer the staged approach?

Thanks — I'll stand up the offer packet drafts once you confirm option.

Marissa
Director, Platform Recruiting

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: People Ops <peopleops@recruiting.co>, FinOps <finops@redwood-partner.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert contract kernel engineer (latency) to FTE + comp band uplift

Team —

Reviewed the packet and cost tradeoffs. Appreciate the context and the pressure on retention. Decision: approve conversion to FTE and a conditional band uplift. Details:

- Headcount: Approved (convert 1 contractor -> 1 FTE).
- Banding: Approve a staged uplift — offer base at high L3 with a written 12-month performance milestone to move to full L4 (this will be formalized in the offer letter). Equity allocation can reflect full L4 on grant, with a 6-month cliff for accelerated RSU vesting tied to milestone completion.
- Funding: Approved to reassign internship Q2 carve as primary funding and draw 20% from kernel hiring reserve. FinOps to confirm exact accounting treatment; expect a small shift in the Q2 hiring pipeline.

Conditions:
1) Manager justification (Mateo) to be included in the packet (2-paragraph).
2) People Ops to prepare docs with staged milestone language and check with legal on accelerated vesting clause.
3) If after 60 days another external offer emerges, this falls back to Exec emergency review for potential full L4 immediate uplift.

@People Ops @FinOps — please proceed with offer paperwork and close the loop on the accounting memo.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
VP, People & Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
